Title: PubChem Molecular Sampler
Description: Returns 100 compounds from PubChem similar to a query, obtained through PubChem's two-dimensional fast similarity service. PubChem aggregates deposited chemical records at a scale far beyond curated bioactivity databases, so neighbours may include screening compounds, natural products and reagents rather than only drug-like chemistry. The request is issued to the public API at run time, meaning results follow the live database and depend on network availability rather than a bundled snapshot.
Interpretation: List of 100 compounds from PubChem structurally similar to the query molecule.
